about: T4 F1b (engine 95, train e95): `request.financial` on the chart's own symbol, rewritten at parse into a data read (`pineFinancial.js::financialCallParts` via `pine.js::eventAsSecurity`), supplied by the financial door only (`financialSupply.js`, never `/api/bars`), placed on the first bar closing at or after each filing's knownFrom (`placeFinancial`), withheld by name where UCT knows no current figure, disclosed as UCT data from company filings, and never graded MATCH. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: the chart's financial entry is handed to the bars door (the synthetic key becomes a /api/bars fetch)
the engine's internal financial name is no longer recognised as one (a script spelling it reads it as a symbol)
a figure steps one session late (the first bar closing strictly AFTER its knownFrom)
gaps_on carries the figure like gaps_off
a GAP point (a filing that left the figure unknown) is no longer unknown
a figure past its staleFrom is carried
mutants.from: else if (!gaps && typeof p.staleFrom === 'string' && ISO.test(p.staleFrom) && sessions[i].close >= p.staleFrom) why = 'stale'

the host lane stops naming a financial read's withheld bars per bar

mutants.mutant: an id UCT does not serve is no longer refused by its own name
the door dark for the member reads as a wait, never a named refusal
mutants.from: return { code: R.FINANCIAL_NOT_AVAILABLE, reason: `financial figures are not available on this chart yet, ${notComputed}` }

a run that read UCT data can grade MATCH again
